blocks.text: The Platform Settings page allows you to configure settings by platform.
The Platform Settings page provides the following benefits:

blocks.item: The flexibility to allow users to authenticate using their device's default browser (or by using WebView2 for Zscaler Ciient Connector version 4.2 and later for Windows).
The simplicity of setting the global default log mode for all new policies at once instead of having to configure the setting for each new customer.

An extra layer of security if you use your own mechanism for deploying Zscaler Client Connector version 4.2.1 and later for Windows on your users' devices. For example, you might use a Group Policy Object (GPO), System Center Configuration Manager (SCCM), or other device management method.

blocks.text: On the Platform Settings page (Infrastructure > Client Connector > OS Name), you can configure settings for each of the following device platforms:
To configure platform settings for Windows, click the Platform Settings tab, and select from the following settings:
For Windows only, users can authenticate in the following two ways:

blocks.item: Using Browser-Based Authentication so that Zscaler Client Connector opens in their device’s default browser.
Using WebView2 for the embedded browser.

blocks.text: If both options are selected, Browser-Based Authentication overrides WebView2.

blocks.item: Enable Browser-Based Authentication.
Enable WebView2 authentication.
